compatibility_effect: Adds the public palimnex.ontology_eval.evaluate_ontology_shadow(root=core.ROOT, *, limit=5) function. It is local-only, deterministic, non-persistent and always reports promotion_authorized false, retrieval_influence false, authority evidence_only and authorizes_actions false.
